title: Sinners

credits.label: Setting
credits.value: A juke joint in Clarksdale, Mississippi, one night in 1932

lead: His first film role. Sammie is a preacher’s son and a blues guitarist. Caton learned guitar for the part, plays a resonator guitar on screen and recorded much of the film’s acoustic guitar.
